verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Γαλιλαίας τῆς Τιβεριάδος
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta apēlthen ho Iēsous peran tēs thalassēs tēs Galilaias tēs Tiberiados
verses.literal: After this Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee ( that is the Sea of Tiberias )
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS disto partiu Jesus para o outro lado do mar da Galiléia, que é o de Tiberíades.

verses.original: ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς ὅτι ἐθεώρουν τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει ἐπὶ τῶν ἀσθενούντων
verses.transliteration: ēkolouthei de autō ochlos polys hoti etheōroun ta sēmeia ha epoiei epi tōn asthenountōn
verses.literal: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick
verses.literalPt: E grande multidão o seguia, porque via os sinais que operava sobre os enfermos.

verses.original: ἀνῆλθεν δὲ εἰς τὸ ὄρος Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: anēlthen de eis to oros Iēsous kai ekei ekathēto meta tōn mathētōn autou
verses.literal: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples
verses.literalPt: E Jesus subiu ao monte, e assentou-se ali com os seus discípulos.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Ēn de engys to pascha hē heortē tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near
verses.literalPt: E a páscoa, a festa dos judeus, estava próxima.

verses.original: ἐπάρας οὖν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος ὅτι πολὺς ὄχλος ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγει πρὸς Φίλιππον Πόθεν ἀγοράσωμεν ἄρτους ἵνα φάγωσιν οὗτοι
verses.transliteration: eparas oun tous ophthalmous ho Iēsous kai theasamenos hoti polys ochlos erchetai pros auton legei pros Philippon Pothen agorasōmen artous hina phagōsin houtoi
verses.literal: When Jesus looked up . . . . . . and saw a large crowd coming toward Him He said to Philip Where can we buy bread for these people to eat
verses.literalPt: Então Jesus, levantando os olhos, e vendo que uma grande multidão vinha ter com ele, disse a Filipe: Onde compraremos pão, para estes comerem?

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν πειράζων αὐτόν αὐτὸς γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἔμελλεν ποιεῖν
verses.transliteration: touto de elegen peirazōn auton autos gar ēdei ti emellen poiein
verses.literal: But He was asking this to test him for He knew what He was about to do
verses.literalPt: Mas dizia isto para o experimentar; porque ele bem sabia o que havia de fazer.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ Φίλιππος Διακοσίων δηναρίων ἄρτοι οὐκ ἀρκοῦσιν αὐτοῖς ἵνα ἕκαστος βραχύ τι λάβῃ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō ho Philippos Diakosiōn dēnariōn artoi ouk arkousin autois hina hekastos brachy ti labē
verses.literal: Philip answered - Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for . . . each of them to have a small piece
verses.literalPt: Filipe respondeu-lhe: Duzentos dinheiros de pão não lhes bastarão, para que cada um deles tome um pouco.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου
verses.transliteration: Legei autō heis ek tōn mathētōn autou Andreas ho adelphos Simōnos Petrou
verses.literal: One of His disciples Andrew Simon Peter’s brother said to Him
verses.literalPt: E um dos seus discípulos, André, irmão de Simão Pedro, disse-lhe:

verses.original: Ἔστιν παιδάριον ὧδε ὃς ἔχει πέντε ἄρτους κριθίνους καὶ δύο ὀψάρια ἀλλὰ ταῦτα τί ἐστιν εἰς τοσούτους
verses.transliteration: Estin paidarion hōde hos echei pente artous krithinous kai dyo opsaria alla tauta ti estin eis tosoutous
verses.literal: Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish But what difference will these make among so many
verses.literalPt: Está aqui um rapaz que tem cinco pães de cevada e dois peixinhos; mas que é isto para tantos?

verses.original: Εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ποιήσατε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἀναπεσεῖν ἦν δὲ χόρτος πολὺς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ἀνέπεσαν οὖν οἱ ἄνδρες τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὡς πεντακισχίλιοι
verses.transliteration: Eipen ho Iēsous Poiēsate tous anthrōpous anapesein ēn de chortos polys en tō topō anepesan oun hoi andres ton arithmon hōs pentakischilioi
verses.literal: Have the people sit down Jesus said Now there was plenty of grass in that place so the men sat down about five thousand of them
verses.literalPt: E disse Jesus: Mandai assentar os homens. E havia muita relva naquele lugar. Assentaram-se, pois, os homens em número de quase cinco mil.

verses.original: Ἔλαβεν οὖν τοὺς ἄρτους ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εὐχαριστήσας διέδωκεν τοῖς ἀνακειμένοις ὁμοίως καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὅσον ἤθελον
verses.transliteration: Elaben oun tous artous ho Iēsous kai eucharistēsas diedōken tois anakeimenois homoiōs kai ek tōn opsariōn hoson ēthelon
verses.literal: Then Jesus took the loaves and . . . the fish gave thanks and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted
verses.literalPt: E Jesus tomou os pães e, havendo dado graças, repartiu-os pelos discípulos, e os discípulos pelos que estavam assentados; e igualmente também dos peixes, quanto eles queriam.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐνεπλήσθησαν λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Συναγάγετε τὰ περισσεύσαντα κλάσματα ἵνα μή τι ἀπόληται
verses.transliteration: Hōs de eneplēsthēsan legei tois mathētais autou Synagagete ta perisseusanta klasmata hina mē ti apolētai
verses.literal: And when everyone was full He said to His disciples Gather the pieces that are left over so that nothing will be wasted
verses.literalPt: E, quando estavam saciados, disse aos seus discípulos: Recolhei os pedaços que sobejaram, para que nada se perca.

verses.original: συνήγαγον οὖν καὶ ἐγέμισαν δώδεκα κοφίνους κλασμάτων ἐκ τῶν πέντε ἄρτων τῶν κριθίνων ἃ ἐπερίσσευσαν τοῖς βεβρωκόσιν
verses.transliteration: synēgagon oun kai egemisan dōdeka kophinous klasmatōn ek tōn pente artōn tōn krithinōn ha eperisseusan tois bebrōkosin
verses.literal: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten
verses.literalPt: Recolheram-nos, pois, e encheram doze alcofas de pedaços dos cinco pães de cevada, que sobejaram aos que haviam comido.

verses.original: Οἱ οὖν ἄνθρωποι ἰδόντες ὃ ἐποίησεν σημεῖον ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης ὁ ἐρχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: Hoi oun anthrōpoi idontes ho epoiēsen sēmeion elegon hoti Houtos estin alēthōs ho prophētēs ho erchomenos eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed they began to say Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, aqueles homens o milagre que Jesus tinha feito, diziam: Este é verdadeiramente o profeta que devia vir ao mundo.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς οὖν γνοὺς ὅτι μέλλουσιν ἔρχεσθαι καὶ ἁρπάζειν αὐτὸν ἵνα ποιήσωσιν βασιλέα ἀνεχώρησεν πάλιν εἰς τὸ ὄρος αὐτὸς μόνος
verses.transliteration: Iēsous oun gnous hoti mellousin erchesthai kai harpazein auton hina poiēsōsin basilea anechōrēsen palin eis to oros autos monos
verses.literal: Then Jesus realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force withdrew again to a mountain by Himself . . .
verses.literalPt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus que haviam de vir arrebatá-lo, para o fazerem rei, tornou a retirar-se, ele só, para o monte.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ὀψία ἐγένετο κατέβησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: Hōs de opsia egeneto katebēsan hoi mathētai autou epi tēn thalassan
verses.literal: When evening came His disciples went down to the sea
verses.literalPt: E, quando veio a tarde, os seus discípulos desceram para o mar.

verses.original: καὶ ἐμβάντες εἰς πλοῖον ἤρχοντο πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς Καφαρναούμ καὶ σκοτία ἤδη ἐγεγόνει καὶ οὔπω ἐληλύθει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: kai embantes eis ploion ērchonto peran tēs thalassēs eis Kapharnaoum kai skotia ēdē egegonei kai oupō elēlythei pros autous ho Iēsous
verses.literal: got into . . . a boat and started across the sea to Capernaum It was already dark and Jesus had not yet gone out to them
verses.literalPt: E, entrando no barco, atravessaram o mar em direção a Cafarnaum; e era já escuro, e ainda Jesus não tinha chegado ao pé deles.

verses.original: ἥ τε θάλασσα ἀνέμου μεγάλου πνέοντος διεγείρετο
verses.transliteration: hē te thalassa anemou megalou pneontos diegeireto
verses.literal: A strong wind was blowing and the sea grew agitated
verses.literalPt: E o mar se levantou, porque um grande vento assoprava.

verses.original: Ἐληλακότες οὖν ὡς σταδίους εἴκοσι πέντε ἢ τριάκοντα θεωροῦσιν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περιπατοῦντα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐγγὺς τοῦ πλοίου γινόμενον καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν
verses.transliteration: Elēlakotes oun hōs stadious eikosi pente ē triakonta theōrousin ton Iēsoun peripatounta epi tēs thalassēs kai engys tou ploiou ginomenon kai ephobēthēsan
verses.literal: When they had rowed about three or four miles . . . . . . . . . . . . they saw Jesus approaching . . . the boat walking on the sea and they were terrified
verses.literalPt: E, tendo navegado uns vinte e cinco ou trinta estádios, viram a Jesus, andando sobre o mar e aproximando-se do barco; e temeram.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐγώ εἰμι μὴ φοβεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: ho de legei autois Egō eimi mē phobeisthe
verses.literal: But Jesus spoke up . . . It is I do not be afraid
verses.literalPt: Mas ele lhes disse: Sou eu, não temais.

verses.original: ἤθελον οὖν λαβεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο τὸ πλοῖον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑπῆγον
verses.transliteration: ēthelon oun labein auton eis to ploion kai eutheōs egeneto to ploion epi tēs gēs eis hēn hypēgon
verses.literal: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat and at once the boat reached . . . the shore where they were heading
verses.literalPt: Então eles de boa mente o receberam no barco; e logo o barco chegou à terra para onde iam.

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ἑστηκὼς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶδον ὅτι πλοιάριον ἄλλο οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖ εἰ μὴ ἕν καὶ ὅτι οὐ συνεισῆλθεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἀλλὰ μόνοι οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον
verses.transliteration: Tē epaurion ho ochlos ho hestēkōs peran tēs thalassēs eidon hoti ploiarion allo ouk ēn ekei ei mē hen kai hoti ou syneisēlthen tois mathētais autou ho Iēsous eis to ploion alla monoi hoi mathētai autou apēlthon
verses.literal: The next day the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only . . . one - boat had been there and that Jesus had not boarded . . . it with His disciples but they had gone away alone
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte, a multidão que estava do outro lado do mar, vendo que não havia ali mais do que um barquinho, a não ser aquele no qual os discípulos haviam entrado, e que Jesus não entrara com os seus discípulos naquele barquinho, mas que os seus discípulos tinham ido sozinhos

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἦλθεν πλοιάρια ἐκ Τιβεριάδος ἐγγὺς τοῦ τόπου ὅπου ἔφαγον τὸν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσαντος τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: alla ēlthen ploiaria ek Tiberiados engys tou topou hopou ephagon ton arton eucharistēsantos tou Kyriou
verses.literal: However some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks
verses.literalPt: (Contudo, outros barquinhos tinham chegado de Tiberíades, perto do lugar onde comeram o pão, havendo o SENHOR dado graças).

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν εἶδεν ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ οὐδὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐνέβησαν αὐτοὶ εἰς τὰ πλοιάρια καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ ζητοῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: hote oun eiden ho ochlos hoti Iēsous ouk estin ekei oude hoi mathētai autou enebēsan autoi eis ta ploiaria kai ēlthon eis Kapharnaoum zētountes ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, a multidão que Jesus não estava ali nem os seus discípulos, entraram eles também nos barcos, e foram a Cafarnaum, em busca de Jesus.

verses.original: καὶ εὑρόντες αὐτὸν πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπον αὐτῷ Ῥαββί πότε ὧδε γέγονας
verses.transliteration: kai heurontes auton peran tēs thalassēs eipon autō Rhabbi pote hōde gegonas
verses.literal: When they found Him on the other side of the sea they asked Him Rabbi when did You get here
verses.literalPt: E, achando-o no outro lado do mar, disseram-lhe: Rabi, quando chegaste aqui?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ζητεῖτέ με οὐχ ὅτι εἴδετε σημεῖα ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἐφάγετε ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων καὶ ἐχορτάσθητε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois ho Iēsous kai eipen Amēn amēn legō hymin zēteite me ouch hoti eidete sēmeia all’ hoti ephagete ek tōn artōn kai echortasthēte
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . Truly truly I tell you it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me but because you ate . . . the loaves and had your fill
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu-lhes, e disse: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que me buscais, não pelos sinais que vistes, mas porque comestes do pão e vos saciastes.

verses.original: ἐργάζεσθε μὴ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν ἀπολλυμένην ἀλλὰ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν μένουσαν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἣν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑμῖν δώσει τοῦτον γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐσφράγισεν ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: ergazesthe mē tēn brōsin tēn apollymenēn alla tēn brōsin tēn menousan eis zōēn aiōnion hēn ho Huios tou anthrōpou hymin dōsei touton gar ho Patēr esphragisen ho Theos
verses.literal: Do not work for food that perishes but for food that endures to eternal life which the Son of Man will give you For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval
verses.literalPt: Trabalhai, não pela comida que perece, mas pela comida que permanece para a vida eterna, a qual o Filho do homem vos dará; porque a este o Pai, Deus, o selou.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν Τί ποιῶμεν ἵνα ἐργαζώμεθα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun pros auton Ti poiōmen hina ergazōmetha ta erga tou Theou
verses.literal: Then they inquired - What must we do to perform the works of God
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Que faremos para executarmos as obras de Deus?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἔργον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα πιστεύητε εἰς ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē ho Iēsous kai eipen autois Touto estin to ergon tou Theou hina pisteuēte eis hon apesteilen ekeinos
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . The work of God is this to believe in the One He has sent
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhes: A obra de Deus é esta: Que creiais naquele que ele enviou.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν ποιεῖς σὺ σημεῖον ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμέν σοι τί ἐργάζῃ
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun autō Ti oun poieis sy sēmeion hina idōmen kai pisteusōmen soi ti ergazē
verses.literal: So they asked Him What sign then will You perform so that we may see it and believe You What will You do
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Que sinal, pois, fazes tu, para que o vejamos, e creiamos em ti? Que operas tu?

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τὸ μάννα ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον Ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: hoi pateres hēmōn to manna ephagon en tē erēmō kathōs estin gegrammenon Arton ek tou ouranou edōken autois phagein
verses.literal: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness as it is written He gave them bread from heaven to eat
verses.literalPt: Nossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, como está escrito: Deu-lhes a comer o pão do céu.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀλλ’ ὁ Πατήρ μου δίδωσιν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν ἀληθινόν
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun autois ho Iēsous Amēn amēn legō hymin ou Mōusēs dedōken hymin ton arton ek tou ouranou all’ ho Patēr mou didōsin hymin ton arton ek tou ouranou ton alēthinon
verses.literal: Jesus said to them Truly truly I tell you it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo: Moisés não vos deu o pão do céu; mas meu Pai vos dá o verdadeiro pão do céu.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἄρτος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ὁ καταβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ζωὴν διδοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: ho gar artos tou Theou estin ho katabainōn ek tou ouranou kai zōēn didous tō kosmō
verses.literal: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world
verses.literalPt: Porque o pão de Deus é aquele que desce do céu e dá vida ao mundo.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν Κύριε πάντοτε δὸς ἡμῖν τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun pros auton Kyrie pantote dos hēmin ton arton touton
verses.literal: Sir they said . . . . . . give us this bread at all times
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois: SENHOR, dá-nos sempre desse pão.

verses.original: Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ πεινάσῃ καὶ ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ διψήσει πώποτε
verses.transliteration: Eipen autois ho Iēsous Egō eimi ho artos tēs zōēs ho erchomenos pros eme ou mē peinasē kai ho pisteuōn eis eme ou mē dipsēsei pōpote
verses.literal: Jesus answered I am the bread of life Whoever comes to Me will never hunger and whoever believes in Me will never thirst
verses.literalPt: E Jesus lhes disse: Eu sou o pão da vida; aquele que vem a mim não terá fome, e quem crê em mim nunca terá sede.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ ἑωράκατέ με καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: all’ eipon hymin hoti kai heōrakate me kai ou pisteuete
verses.literal: But as I stated . . . you have seen Me and still you do not believe
verses.literalPt: Mas já vos disse que também vós me vistes, e contudo não credes.

verses.original: Πᾶν ὃ δίδωσίν μοι ὁ Πατὴρ πρὸς ἐμὲ ἥξει καὶ τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρός με οὐ μὴ ἐκβάλω ἔξω
verses.transliteration: Pan ho didōsin moi ho Patēr pros eme hēxei kai ton erchomenon pros me ou mē ekbalō exō
verses.literal: Everyone . . . the Father gives Me will come to Me and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away
verses.literalPt: Todo o que o Pai me dá virá a mim; e o que vem a mim de maneira nenhuma o lançarei fora.

verses.original: ὅτι καταβέβηκα ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐχ ἵνα ποιῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με
verses.transliteration: hoti katabebēka apo tou ouranou ouch hina poiō to thelēma to emon alla to thelēma tou pempsantos me
verses.literal: For I have come down from heaven not to do My own will but to do the will of Him who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Porque eu desci do céu, não para fazer a minha vontade, mas a vontade daquele que me enviou.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκέν μοι μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: Touto de estin to thelēma tou pempsantos me hina pan ho dedōken moi mē apolesō ex autou alla anastēsō auto en tē eschatē hēmera
verses.literal: And this is the will of Him who sent Me that I shall lose none of - those He has given Me but raise them up . . . at the last day
verses.literalPt: E a vontade do Pai que me enviou é esta: Que nenhum de todos aqueles que me deu se perca, mas que o ressuscite no último dia.

verses.original: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Πατρός μου ἵνα πᾶς ὁ θεωρῶν τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐγὼ ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: touto gar estin to thelēma tou Patros mou hina pas ho theōrōn ton Huion kai pisteuōn eis auton echē zōēn aiōnion kai anastēsō auton egō en tē eschatē hēmera
verses.literal: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life and I will raise him up . . . at the last day
verses.literalPt: Porquanto a vontade daquele que me enviou é esta: Que todo aquele que vê o Filho, e crê nele, tenha a vida eterna; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.

verses.original: Ἐγόγγυζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι εἶπεν Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ καταβὰς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egongyzon oun hoi Ioudaioi peri autou hoti eipen Egō eimi ho artos ho katabas ek tou ouranou
verses.literal: At this the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said I am the bread that came down from heaven
verses.literalPt: Murmuravam, pois, dele os judeus, porque dissera: Eu sou o pão que desceu do céu.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωσήφ οὗ ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα πῶς νῦν λέγει ὅτι Ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβέβηκα
verses.transliteration: kai elegon Ouch houtos estin Iēsous ho huios Iōsēph hou hēmeis oidamen ton patera kai tēn mētera pōs nyn legei hoti Ek tou ouranou katabebēka
verses.literal: They were asking Is this not Jesus the son of Joseph whose father and mother we know How then can He say I have come down from heaven
verses.literalPt: E diziam: Não é este Jesus, o filho de José, cujo pai e mãe nós conhecemos? Como, pois, diz ele: Desci do céu?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μὴ γογγύζετε μετ’ ἀλλήλων
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois Mē gongyzete met’ allēlōn
verses.literal: Stop grumbling among yourselves Jesus replied . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondeu, pois, Jesus, e disse-lhes: Não murmureis entre vós.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ πέμψας με ἑλκύσῃ αὐτόν κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: oudeis dynatai elthein pros me ean mē ho Patēr ho pempsas me helkysē auton kagō anastēsō auton en tē eschatē hēmera
verses.literal: No one can come to Me unless . . . the Father who sent Me draws him and I will raise him up . . . at the last day
verses.literalPt: Ninguém pode vir a mim, se o Pai que me enviou o não trouxer; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.

verses.original: ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις Καὶ ἔσονται πάντες διδακτοὶ Θεοῦ πᾶς ὁ ἀκούσας παρὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ μαθὼν ἔρχεται πρὸς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: estin gegrammenon en tois prophētais Kai esontai pantes didaktoi Theou pas ho akousas para tou Patros kai mathōn erchetai pros eme
verses.literal: It is written in the Prophets And they will all be . . . taught by God Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me
verses.literalPt: Está escrito nos profetas: E serão todos ensinados por Deus. Portanto, todo aquele que do Pai ouviu e aprendeu vem a mim.

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι τὸν Πατέρα ἑώρακέν τις εἰ μὴ ὁ ὢν παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὗτος ἑώρακεν τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: ouch hoti ton Patera heōraken tis ei mē ho ōn para tou Theou houtos heōraken ton Patera
verses.literal: not that anyone has seen the Father except . . . the One who is from God only He has seen the Father
verses.literalPt: Não que alguém visse ao Pai, a não ser aquele que é de Deus; este tem visto ao Pai.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ πιστεύων ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin ho pisteuōn echei zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you he who believes has eternal life
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que aquele que crê em mim tem a vida eterna.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: egō eimi ho artos tēs zōēs
verses.literal: I am the bread of life
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o pão da vida.

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ μάννα καὶ ἀπέθανον
verses.transliteration: hoi pateres hymōn ephagon en tē erēmō to manna kai apethanon
verses.literal: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness yet they died
verses.literalPt: Vossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, e morreram.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβαίνων ἵνα τις ἐξ αὐτοῦ φάγῃ καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ
verses.transliteration: houtos estin ho artos ho ek tou ouranou katabainōn hina tis ex autou phagē kai mē apothanē
verses.literal: This is the bread that comes down from heaven so that anyone may eat of it and not die
verses.literalPt: Este é o pão que desce do céu, para que o que dele comer não morra.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ζῶν ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς ἐάν τις φάγῃ ἐκ τούτου τοῦ ἄρτου ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ὁ ἄρτος δὲ ὃν ἐγὼ δώσω ἡ σάρξ μού ἐστιν ὑπὲρ τῆς τοῦ κόσμου ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: egō eimi ho artos ho zōn ho ek tou ouranou katabas ean tis phagē ek toutou tou artou zēsei eis ton aiōna kai ho artos de hon egō dōsō hē sarx mou estin hyper tēs tou kosmou zōēs
verses.literal: I am the living bread that came down from heaven If anyone eats of this bread he will live forever And this bread which I will give for the life of the world is My flesh
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o pão vivo que desceu do céu; se alguém comer deste pão, viverá para sempre; e o pão que eu der é a minha carne, que eu darei pela vida do mundo.

verses.original: Ἐμάχοντο οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες Πῶς δύναται οὗτος ἡμῖν δοῦναι τὴν σάρκα αὐτοῦ φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: Emachonto oun pros allēlous hoi Ioudaioi legontes Pōs dynatai houtos hēmin dounai tēn sarka autou phagein
verses.literal: At this the Jews began to argue among themselves How can this man give us His flesh to eat
verses.literalPt: Disputavam, pois, os judeus entre si, dizendo: Como nos pode dar este a sua carne a comer?

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐὰν μὴ φάγητε τὴν σάρκα τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πίητε αὐτοῦ τὸ αἷμα οὐκ ἔχετε ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun autois ho Iēsous Amēn amēn legō hymin ean mē phagēte tēn sarka tou Huiou tou anthrōpou kai piēte autou to haima ouk echete zōēn en heautois
verses.literal: So Jesus said to them Truly truly I tell you unless . . . you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man you have no life in you
verses.literalPt: Jesus, pois, lhes disse: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que, se não comerdes a carne do Filho do homem, e não beberdes o seu sangue, não tereis vida em vós mesmos.

verses.original: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: ho trōgōn mou tēn sarka kai pinōn mou to haima echei zōēn aiōnion kagō anastēsō auton tē eschatē hēmera
verses.literal: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life and I will raise him up . . . at the last day
verses.literalPt: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue tem a vida eterna, e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ σάρξ μου ἀληθής ἐστιν βρῶσις καὶ τὸ αἷμά μου ἀληθής ἐστιν πόσις
verses.transliteration: hē gar sarx mou alēthēs estin brōsis kai to haima mou alēthēs estin posis
verses.literal: For My flesh is real food and My blood is real drink
verses.literalPt: Porque a minha carne verdadeiramente é comida, e o meu sangue verdadeiramente é bebida.

verses.original: Ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μένει κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho trōgōn mou tēn sarka kai pinōn mou to haima en emoi menei kagō en autō
verses.literal: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me and I in him
verses.literalPt: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue permanece em mim e eu nele.

verses.original: καθὼς ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ ζῶν Πατὴρ κἀγὼ ζῶ διὰ τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ὁ τρώγων με κἀκεῖνος ζήσει δι’ ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: kathōs apesteilen me ho zōn Patēr kagō zō dia ton Patera kai ho trōgōn me kakeinos zēsei di’ eme
verses.literal: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me
verses.literalPt: Assim como o Pai, que vive, me enviou, e eu vivo pelo Pai, assim, quem de mim se alimenta, também viverá por mim.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς οὐ καθὼς ἔφαγον οἱ πατέρες καὶ ἀπέθανον ὁ τρώγων τοῦτον τὸν ἄρτον ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: houtos estin ho artos ho ex ouranou katabas ou kathōs ephagon hoi pateres kai apethanon ho trōgōn touton ton arton zēsei eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: This is the bread that came down from heaven Unlike . . . your fathers who ate the manna and died the one who eats this bread will live forever
verses.literalPt: Este é o pão que desceu do céu; não é o caso de vossos pais, que comeram o maná e morreram; quem comer este pão viverá para sempre.

verses.original: Ταῦτα εἶπεν ἐν συναγωγῇ διδάσκων ἐν Καφαρναούμ
verses.transliteration: Tauta eipen en synagōgē didaskōn en Kapharnaoum
verses.literal: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum
verses.literalPt: Ele disse estas coisas na sinagoga, ensinando em Cafarnaum.

verses.original: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἀκούσαντες ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπαν Σκληρός ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος τίς δύναται αὐτοῦ ἀκούειν
verses.transliteration: Polloi oun akousantes ek tōn mathētōn autou eipan Sklēros estin ho logos houtos tis dynatai autou akouein
verses.literal: On hearing it many of His disciples said This is a difficult teaching Who can accept it
verses.literalPt: Muitos, pois, dos seus discípulos, ouvindo isto, disseram: Duro é este discurso; quem o pode ouvir?

verses.original: Εἰδὼς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὅτι γογγύζουσιν περὶ τούτου οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτο ὑμᾶς σκανδαλίζει
verses.transliteration: Eidōs de ho Iēsous en heautō hoti gongyzousin peri toutou hoi mathētai autou eipen autois Touto hymas skandalizei
verses.literal: Aware . . . . . . that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching Jesus asked them Does this offend you
verses.literalPt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus em si mesmo que os seus discípulos murmuravam disto, disse-lhes: Isto escandaliza-vos?

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν θεωρῆτε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀναβαίνοντα ὅπου ἦν τὸ πρότερον
verses.transliteration: ean oun theōrēte ton Huion tou anthrōpou anabainonta hopou ēn to proteron
verses.literal: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before
verses.literalPt: Que seria, pois, se vísseis subir o Filho do homem para onde primeiro estava?

verses.original: Τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ ζωοποιοῦν ἡ σὰρξ οὐκ ὠφελεῖ οὐδέν τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λελάληκα ὑμῖν πνεῦμά ἐστιν καὶ ζωή ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: To pneuma estin to zōopoioun hē sarx ouk ōphelei ouden ta rhēmata ha egō lelalēka hymin pneuma estin kai zōē estin
verses.literal: The Spirit - gives life the flesh profits nothing The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life
verses.literalPt: O espírito é o que vivifica, a carne para nada aproveita; as palavras que eu vos disse são espírito e vida.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ εἰσὶν ἐξ ὑμῶν τινες οἳ οὐ πιστεύουσιν ᾔδει γὰρ ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ μὴ πιστεύοντες καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδώσων αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: all’ eisin ex hymōn tines hoi ou pisteuousin ēdei gar ex archēs ho Iēsous tines eisin hoi mē pisteuontes kai tis estin ho paradōsōn auton
verses.literal: However there are some of you who do not believe (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who - would betray Him
verses.literalPt: Mas há alguns de vós que não crêem. Porque bem sabia Jesus, desde o princípio, quem eram os que não criam, e quem era o que o havia de entregar.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν Διὰ τοῦτο εἴρηκα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ Πατρός
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen Dia touto eirēka hymin hoti oudeis dynatai elthein pros me ean mē ē dedomenon autō ek tou Patros
verses.literal: Then Jesus said This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless . . . the Father has granted it to him
verses.literalPt: E dizia: Por isso eu vos disse que ninguém pode vir a mim, se por meu Pai não lhe for concedido.

verses.original: Ἐκ τούτου πολλοὶ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ οὐκέτι μετ’ αὐτοῦ περιεπάτουν
verses.transliteration: Ek toutou polloi ek tōn mathētōn autou apēlthon eis ta opisō kai ouketi met’ autou periepatoun
verses.literal: From that time on many of His disciples turned back . . . . . . . . . and no longer walked with Him
verses.literalPt: Desde então muitos dos seus discípulos tornaram para trás, e já não andavam com ele.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς δώδεκα Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε ὑπάγειν
verses.transliteration: eipen oun ho Iēsous tois dōdeka Mē kai hymeis thelete hypagein
verses.literal: So Jesus asked the Twelve Do you want to leave too
verses.literalPt: Então disse Jesus aos doze: Quereis vós também retirar-vos?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος Κύριε πρὸς τίνα ἀπελευσόμεθα ῥήματα ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἔχεις
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō Simōn Petros Kyrie pros tina apeleusometha rhēmata zōēs aiōniou echeis
verses.literal: Simon Peter replied Lord to whom would we go You have the words of eternal life
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe, pois, Simão Pedro: Senhor, para quem iremos nós? Tu tens as palavras da vida eterna.

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς πεπιστεύκαμεν καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hēmeis pepisteukamen kai egnōkamen hoti sy ei ho Hagios tou Theou
verses.literal: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God
verses.literalPt: E nós temos crido e conhecido que tu és o Cristo, o Filho do Deus vivente.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐκ ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς τοὺς δώδεκα ἐξελεξάμην καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν εἷς διάβολός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois ho Iēsous Ouk egō hymas tous dōdeka exelexamēn kai ex hymōn heis diabolos estin
verses.literal: Jesus answered them Have I not chosen you the Twelve Yet one of you is a devil
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Não vos escolhi a vós os doze? e um de vós é um diabo.

verses.original: ἔλεγεν δὲ τὸν Ἰούδαν Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου οὗτος γὰρ ἔμελλεν παραδιδόναι αὐτόν εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: elegen de ton Ioudan Simōnos Iskariōtou houtos gar emellen paradidonai auton heis ek tōn dōdeka
verses.literal: He was speaking about Judas the son of Simon Iscariot For although Judas was one of the Twelve he was later to betray Jesus
verses.literalPt: E isto dizia ele de Judas Iscariotes, filho de Simão; porque este o havia de entregar, sendo um dos doze.
